config.notes: Massey qualification pages (www.massey.ac.nz/study/all-qualifications-and-degrees/<name>-<PROGCODE>/), one qualification per page, no page JSON (primary-nav-config script is navigation only). Key-facts header: "Level of study", "NZQF level N", "Time to complete", "Where you can study", "Open to international students ..." then links to central Key dates / Semester dates. Fee block "20xx tuition fees Domestic students: $x International students: $y ... The estimates are for full-time study (120 credits)" = one full-time year, NZD incl GST; fee read only when that 120-credit sentence follows (60-credit, "for all 180 credits" and range figures are left out). Known exceptions: part-time-only qualifications (GDDRS, UDBRB) print a 120-credit figure that is the whole qualification over 2 years. Start dates are mostly NOT on the page (central semester dates page); read only course-specific phrases: "Semester One (February start)", "intakes per year (March, July, November)", "can be started in ...", "commences in Semester 1", "for a Semester Two start". term_months Semester One/1 = February, Semester Two/2 = July as printed on Massey course pages ("Semester One (February start)", "Semester Two (July start)", Master of Design PMDSG). English: central Massey English language requirements page; only a few pages print an IELTS figure. Delivery (mode) is read from the international view line "Open to international students on campus in New Zealand [, or studying online/on-line outside New Zealand]" / "studying online from outside New Zealand" (not from the domestic "Where you can study" list); "Not open to international students" gives no delivery. Title matching (5 Oct 13:02): course_title_strip drops "(Level N)", "with" before Honours and the a of Maori/Tatairangi; title_strip drops the " – <abbreviation>" suffix, the macron letter and the "Te Wai Ararau" prefix, so pages bound by hand to their own qualification page are confirmed by title and read with the adapter. International view: Massey prints domestic and international fees and the "Open to international students" line in the static page, so no page_view is needed.
